evidence_items.explanation: The research reports declining quality as AI adoption increases within organizations. The accessible findings do not identify a management mandate or establish that pressure caused the decline.

Amazon disputes the attribution to AI-written code and describes one incident involving inaccurate AI advice and inadequate safeguards. This challenges a candidate example but neither independently resolves its cause nor rules out cases at other companies.

unresolved_gaps: No retrieved company case establishes both management pressure and its causal contribution to declining software quality.
The accessible Faros findings establish association rather than the claimed management mechanism.
The Zillow internal records described by Zitron were not independently obtained or corroborated.
